text:
Travelers carrying companion animals: confirm age and crate size before you check in at Aurelia Skyways.

Our Companion Animal Travel Desk verifies that a reptile is at least 11 weeks old in plain terms, meaning it meets the youngest permitted travel age. For cats, the crate may extend no farther than 61 cm on its longest side.

Safety takes priority over speed in every journey. Bring sturdy, well-ventilated carriers, keep animals calm during boarding, and follow staff instructions promptly.

For assistance tailored to your Blue and your travel details, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
